issue.title: Guard fast-path bead writes before Rust context reads
issue.description: On c2aec595c8, tests/main/test_bead_fast_path.py::test_fast_path_refuses_unsafe_resolved_location_before_rust and ::test_fast_path_refuses_mutation_from_plain_checkout_sidecar_record fail because operation_context._descriptor_for_location invokes bead_list through Rust before the unsafe-write guard rejects the target. The mocked require_rust_binding is imported into a facade during these tests and poisons a later create-attribution test; that third node passes alone. Ensure write safety is checked before a Rust context read or adjust the guard tests to distinguish safe reads from writes, with no unsafe write reaching the binding. Proposing bead: sase-1ck.4.1.2 note 2.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both guard nodes fail in serial runs on current clean HEAD; the create-attribution node passes alone, confirming a cascade rather than a third independent regression.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1ck.4.1.2 proposed five clean-tree bead fast-path failures; the current tree reproduces two guard failures independently and a third failure cascades from their mocked binding.

payload.description: checking whether pre-existing check failure is already tracked

evidence.note: Independent repro by sase-1hf.land on master 3a4178b15a (2026-10-07, serial pytest): tests/main/test_bead_fast_path.py::test_fast_path_refuses_unsafe_resolved_location_before_rust and ::test_fast_path_refuses_mutation_from_plain_checkout_sidecar_record still fail ('unsafe bead write reached Rust binding' / 'read-only bead mutation reached Rust binding'). ::test_fast_path_guards_mutations_but_not_reads now also fails ('DID NOT RAISE RuntimeError' for the fast-path mutation guard). Also reported by sase-1hf.5 note #2. Not caused by sase-1hf (its diff touches no bead fast-path code).
